question: A film editor named Bao had a rough cut that ran 190 minutes, and the studio wants runtimes in hours, so he knows that sixty minutes make an hour and will convert when he is done. He trimmed 43 minutes of slow scenes. The director then asked him to add back a 28-minute battle sequence and a 29-minute flashback. Bao also added 24 minutes of end credits and bonus footage. The film has 6 main characters and took a dozen weeks to shoot. How many minutes long is the cut now?

At the arcade Milo had 155 prize tickets and spent 151 of them on a stuffed dinosaur. A bonus machine then tripled the tickets he had left. Over the next hour he won 56 tickets at skee-ball, 50 at the basketball hoop, and 48 at the claw machine. How many prize tickets does Milo have now?

In the morning the Rise and Shine bakery had 139 bagels on its racks and sold 56 of them before nine. A customer returned 3 bagels that were the wrong flavour, and those went back on the rack. In the afternoon a cafe down the street bought a dozen, and 15 more went to the staff for lunch. The bakery runs 4 ovens. In the evening the baker put out 57 fresh bagels for the dinner crowd. How many bagels are on the racks now?

The Seaview Hotel had 140 clean towels in its linen room. The hotel has 48 guest rooms. Housekeeping sent 119 of the towels out to be laundered. Later that day 65 towels came back from the laundry and a delivery brought 35 brand-new towels. The pool attendant then took 100 towels down to the pool deck. How many towels are in the linen room now?

Tomas rode his bike 107 kilometres on each of 6 days during a tour he had spent a dozen days planning. His bike weighs 9 kilograms. When his tracking app crashed it wiped 613 kilometres from his logged total. He rode 46 kilometres the next day and 57 kilometres the day after, and both rides were logged. The app displays distance in metres rather than kilometres, so Tomas keeps in mind that a thousand metres make a kilometre. How many kilometres does the app show as his logged total now?

The children's shelf at the Maple Street library held 197 books when the doors opened in the morning. During the morning 107 books were borrowed from that shelf. In the afternoon 67 books were returned to it and a librarian added 63 newly purchased books. In the evening another 43 returned books were put back on the shelf. How many books are on the children's shelf at closing time?

In the morning Emil counted 203 marbles in his bag, and his friend Faye, who had only 44 marbles and therefore far fewer than Emil, gave him all of hers. The tournament that day had 10 rounds. During the morning rounds Emil lost 244 marbles. In the afternoon a trader offered him 6 marbles for every marble he had left, and Emil accepted, handing over all of his marbles. In the evening he lost 9 marbles in a final game and then won 28 in a rematch. How many marbles does Emil have now?

Jae keeps a study timer in minutes, though her school reports study time in hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. On Monday her timer started with 134 minutes of planned study. In the morning she used 55 minutes on chemistry, in the afternoon 60 minutes on history, and in the evening 10 minutes on vocabulary. Her tutor then added 56 minutes of extra review to what remained on the timer and told her that this final amount is what she should study on each of the next 8 evenings. How many minutes will Jae study over those 8 evenings?

Nadia bought 8 packs of stickers; each pack holds 9 sheets and each sheet has 147 stickers, and those stickers became her whole collection. She divided the collection equally among 6 people, herself included, and kept only her own share as her collection. She then used 852 stickers from her collection to decorate a notebook. A sticker club offered 9 new stickers for every sticker turned in, and Nadia turned in her entire remaining collection for new ones. Her class has 27 students. She then gave 4634 stickers to the classroom craft box. How many stickers does Nadia have now?

Lena's quiz team earned 48 points in the opening round, and the points were shared equally among the 6 team members as their personal scores. In the second round, which lasted half an hour, Lena added 54 points to her score. In the third round she added 34 more. Lena then scored exactly that same weekly total in each of the 9 weeks of the league season. How many points did Lena score over the whole season?

A tour company sends coaches to the coast each morning. Today each coach left with 126 passengers, picked up 43 more at the station, and dropped 79 off at the harbour, and that was the load on each of the 4 coaches that ran. At the coast all of the passengers from those 4 coaches were divided equally among 4 hotels. The Beacon Hotel, one of them, also took in 38 walk-in guests that evening, after a wait of half an hour at the desk. How many guests did the Beacon Hotel take in that day?

Ms. Ruiz keeps the pencil supply for her school. Each box the supplier sends holds 196 pencils, and the supplier tucks 16 extra pencils into every box as a bonus. She received 5 such boxes, which made up the whole supply. The school has 22 classrooms. A teacher then returned 77 unused pencils from last term, and a parent donated 19 more. How many pencils are in the supply now?

The Rialto theatre keeps a stock of printed programmes. The printer delivered 6 boxes with 102 programmes in each, and that was the whole stock. A leak in the storeroom ruined 96 programmes, which were thrown out. An usher then returned 17 programmes that had been left on seats, and they went back into the stock. With a long run of shows ahead, the manager ordered a reprint that tripled the stock. How many programmes are in the stock now?

Nora tracks her reading in minutes, though her reading app reports hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. On Sunday she read for 84 minutes, split equally among 6 books. For her weekday plan she decided to read each book for 5 minutes less than that Sunday share, to read 3 books in every session, and to have 2 sessions a day. The library lets her borrow up to 10 books at a time. She followed the plan for 9 days. How many minutes did Nora read over those 9 days?

In the morning 8 boxes of floor tiles, each holding 162 tiles, arrived at a renovation site, and the tiles were shared equally among the 4 tilers working there. In the afternoon the foreman gave Ana, one of the tilers, 40 extra tiles from the van. Ana laid all of her tiles in 4 equal rows across the hallway floor, which took her half an hour. The hallway is 5 metres wide. In the evening she measured the next room and found it would need 7 rows of exactly the same size as those hallway rows. How many tiles does Ana need for the next room?

Jess and Cal were making bread and measured in grams, though the recipe was written in kilograms and they knew a thousand grams make a kilogram. Jess put 156 grams of flour into the bowl and Cal stirred in 38 grams of seeds, so Jess contributed more to the bowl than Cal did. They made 2 bowls exactly like that and combined them into one big batch. They divided the batch equally into 4 loaves. Their cafe then ordered 7 loaves of exactly that size for the weekend. How many grams of dough do Jess and Cal need for the cafe order?

Each of the 9 campers at Pine Lake started Saturday morning with 230 cents of tuck-shop money, and every camper spent it in exactly the same way. In the morning each spent 193 cents on a sandwich and then 16 cents on a stamp. In the afternoon the camp leader made each camper's remaining money 2 times as large as a reward for a tidy cabin. In the evening each camper spent 39 cents on hot chocolate. The tuck shop keeps its accounts in dollars rather than cents, and the leader knows that a hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents do the 9 campers have left altogether?

On the morning of the fair Ines had 121 balloons ready, but 43 popped in the heat before the gates opened. Her helper Kofi arrived with 57 balloons of his own, fewer than Ines had started with, and added them to her bunch. In the afternoon they handed 132 balloons to children over half an hour. In the evening Ines inflated 75 more for the fireworks crowd. How many balloons does Ines have now?

Mira busks in the subway and counts her takings in cents, though the busking permit fee is quoted in dollars and she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. On Monday she earned 222 cents in each of 5 hours of playing, and then some passers-by dropped in 23 cents, 24 cents and 37 cents as she packed up. Her guitar has 6 strings. She spent 698 cents on dinner on the way home. Mira ended each of 7 days with exactly the same amount as Monday and saved all of it. How many cents did she save over those 7 days?

The Westbrook school counts every book it owns. Each classroom started the year with 202 books and received 76 more from the district, and there are 7 classrooms stocked exactly that way, which made up the entire count. The school building has 3 floors. The librarian then added 67 reference books to the count, and a parent donated 24 picture books. How many books does the school own now?

The new Riverside stadium has 201 seats in each block, 4 blocks in each stand, and 8 stands around the pitch. The club also fitted 14 seats in the press box, 78 seats in the hospitality suite and 26 seats in the family lounge. The stadium opened 30 years after the old ground was built, and half of the seats are painted blue. How many seats does the stadium have in total?

Each of the 4 rain tanks on Kwame's farm held 168 litres on Monday, and he tracks water in litres although the pump gauge reads in millilitres, a thousand of which make a litre. From every tank he drew 44 litres for the goats and then 105 litres for the vegetable beds, and all 4 tanks were used identically. Each tank stands 2 metres tall. A cracked pipe then lost 8 litres from the combined supply. An overnight shower added 43 litres across the tanks. How many litres of water do the tanks hold altogether now?

In the morning Mia picked 109 strawberries, then 19 more after a short break and another 43 before lunch, and she divided the whole pick equally into 3 punnets. In the afternoon she ate 43 strawberries out of one punnet over half an hour. In the evening she decided that what was left in that punnet was the perfect size for a market punnet, and she planned to pack 9 punnets of that size on each of 4 market days. How many strawberries will Mia need for those 4 market days?

The Northside gym keeps a stack of exercise mats, which held 224 mats in September. A delivery added 19 mats. Then 188 mats were lent to the primary school for its sports day. A sponsor donated 52 mats to the stack. For the regional tournament the district sent enough mats to triple the stack, and the whole stack was then divided equally among the 3 gyms hosting events, with Northside keeping one of those equal shares as its stack. How many mats are in the Northside stack now?

In the morning Ana's taco truck sold 6 batches of 86 tacos, then 77 more before noon, and another 19 just after. In the afternoon the owners compared notes and found that Luis's truck had sold exactly the same number as Ana's truck, so the 2 trucks had matching totals so far. In the evening Ana sold 66 more tacos and Luis sold 57 more, so Ana's evening sales beat Luis's. How many tacos did the 2 trucks sell that day altogether?
